title: Strawberry Beer Bread with Fresh Basil
description: Fresh basil is the perfect complement to strawberries in this sweet, fruity beer bread that's a delicious addition to a pork or chicken dinner, or toasted and served by itself!
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle fruity beer
0.5 cup loosely packed chopped fresh basil leaves
1 tablespoon coarse sugar, or as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray.

Stir flour and white sugar together in a large mixing bowl. Pour in beer and stir. Add strawberries and basil and stir until well combined; batter will be stiff and sticky. Scoop batter into the prepared loaf pan. Sprinkle the top generously with coarse sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes.
